name: FocusFlow
description: Pomodoro timer app with work/break intervals, session history, and customizable timers

screens.name: TimerScreen
screens.purpose: Main Pomodoro timer with circular progress and controls

features.name: circular-timer
features.description: Animated circular progress ring with gradient stroke showing remaining time

features.name: timer-controls
features.description: Start, pause, reset buttons with haptic feedback on interaction

features.name: session-indicator
features.description: Display current session type and count toward long break

features.name: auto-transitions
features.description: Automatically switch between work and break intervals based on settings

features.name: background-gradient
features.description: Soft gradient background that changes color based on session type

screens.layout: Centered circular timer with large time display, session type badge above, control buttons below, gradient background

screens.name: HistoryScreen
screens.purpose: List of completed Pomodoro sessions with filtering

features.name: session-list
features.description: Scrollable list of past sessions grouped by date with swipe actions

features.name: session-cards
features.description: Cards showing session type, duration, completion time with gradient accents

features.name: date-grouping
features.description: Sessions grouped by day with relative date headers

features.name: filter-options
features.description: Filter by session type: all, work, short break, long break

features.name: delete-session
features.description: Swipe to delete individual sessions with haptic confirmation

screens.layout: Scrollable list with date section headers, session cards with icons, filter chips at top

screens.name: StatsScreen
screens.purpose: Visual statistics and insights about focus sessions

features.name: summary-cards
features.description: Total sessions, focus time, and completion rate in gradient cards

features.name: weekly-chart
features.description: Bar chart showing daily session counts for the past week

features.name: session-breakdown
features.description: Pie chart displaying work vs break session distribution

features.name: streak-tracker
features.description: Current and longest streak of consecutive days with sessions

features.name: time-period-selector
features.description: Toggle between week, month, and all-time statistics view

screens.layout: Scrollable view with summary cards at top, charts in middle, streak info at bottom, all with dark cards

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Customize timer durations and app preferences

features.name: duration-pickers
features.description: Adjust work, short break, and long break durations with slider inputs

features.name: long-break-interval
features.description: Set number of work sessions before triggering a long break

features.name: auto-start-toggles
features.description: Enable auto-start for breaks and work sessions independently

features.name: notification-settings
features.description: Toggle sound and haptic feedback for session transitions

features.name: reset-stats
features.description: Clear all session history with confirmation dialog

screens.layout: Grouped settings sections with sliders, toggles, and buttons in dark cards with labels

screens.name: OnboardingScreen
screens.purpose: Welcome new users and explain Pomodoro technique

features.name: swipeable-slides
features.description: Horizontal swipeable slides explaining work intervals, breaks, and benefits

features.name: gradient-backgrounds
features.description: Each slide has unique gradient matching session type colors

features.name: animated-icons
features.description: Large animated icons illustrating each concept with smooth transitions

features.name: progress-dots
features.description: Dot indicators showing current slide position with animations

features.name: quick-setup
features.description: Final slide allows setting initial timer preferences before starting

screens.layout: Full-screen slides with centered icon, title, description, progress dots at bottom, skip/next buttons
